title: Pharmacy
subtitle: Dispensing of validated prescriptions, billing and lot-based stock

stock.empty: No pharmacy product in the catalogue
stock.notice: Expired lots are never dispensed. Issue follows first-expired, first-out.
stock.adjustBody: Inventory correction: reason required, movement traced, stock never negative.
stock.deltaHint: Negative to remove · Change expressed in the base unit (e.g. tablets) for packaged products

import.title: Import lots from Excel
import.help: Each row of the file is the receipt of one lot. A product missing from the catalogue is added automatically (with its price) and then stocked. Everything is checked before writing: if any row has an error, nothing is imported.
import.columns: Columns: Code (optional) and/or Product, Price (required for a new product, ignored for an existing one), Lot number, Expiry (optional), Quantity (positive whole number). The first sheet is read; the first row holds the headers.
import.summary: {{file}}: {{ok}} valid row(s), {{errors}} error(s), {{created}} product(s) to add to the catalogue.
import.errorsTitle: Fix the file, then choose it again:
import.fixFirst: No lot is imported while the file contains errors.

fatal.missingColumns: Columns not found: at least Code (or Product), Lot number and Quantity are required.
fatal.empty: The file contains no rows to import.
fatal.tooMany: The file has too many rows (maximum {{max}}).

read.notXlsx: This file is not a readable Excel workbook (.xlsx).
read.unsupported: This browser cannot read this compressed workbook. Save it again as a standard .xlsx or use a recent browser.

problem.itemUnknown: Row {{row}}: product not found in the pharmacy catalogue (“{{value}}”).
problem.lotRequired: Row {{row}}: the lot number is required.
problem.quantityInvalid: Row {{row}}: invalid quantity (“{{value}}”) — a positive whole number is expected.
problem.alreadyExpired: Row {{row}}: the lot is already expired ({{value}}).
problem.duplicateInFile: Row {{row}}: lot “{{value}}” appears twice for this product in the file.
problem.lotExists: Row {{row}}: lot “{{value}}” already exists for this product.
problem.codeMismatch: Row {{row}}: code “{{value}}” does not match this product already in the catalogue.
problem.codeInvalid: Row {{row}}: invalid code, or already used in the file (“{{value}}”) — 2 to 20 letters, digits or hyphens.
problem.labelLength: Row {{row}}: the name must be 2 to 120 characters long (“{{value}}”).
problem.priceRequired: Row {{row}}: “{{value}}” is not in the catalogue: give its price to add it.
problem.priceInvalid: Row {{row}}: invalid price (“{{value}}”) — a number above 0 with at most 2 decimals.

stock.search: Search by product, code or lot number
stock.inUzishaBody: Receipts, lots, expiry dates and inventory corrections are done in UZISHA. Here the pharmacy prepares and hands over prescriptions: the server picks the lots and refuses insufficient stock. Medicines, their prices and sale units are managed in the “Catalogue and prices” tab.

prepare.title: Prepare dispensation — {{number}}
prepare.description: For each prescribed line, choose the stock product to hand over.
prepare.notice: The invoice is created now; stock only leaves at hand-over, after payment. No product matching is done automatically.
prepare.reasonPlaceholder: E.g. out of stock, equivalent generic, patient declined

dispensation.title: Dispensation
dispensation.description: Handing products to the patient. Administration belongs to nursing.
dispensation.noInvoice: Invoice not found: hand-over is blocked.
dispensation.refundPending: a payment was collected, refund to be made at the cashier
dispensation.gateHint: Hand-over is possible after payment, authorised credit or a justified exception.
dispensation.exceptionBody: Exception reserved for emergencies, traced with your name and the reason.
dispensation.cancelBody: Possible before hand-over. An unpaid invoice is cancelled; a payment must be refunded at the cashier.
